newsitem.title: ITALY: Luxottica in accord with Bulgari.
newsitem.headline: Luxottica in accord with Bulgari.

text.p: New York quoted Italian optical giant Luxottica Group SpA said it has signed a letter of intent with Italian luxury jeweller Bulgari SpA to manufacture and distribute a collection of optical frames and sunglasses.

Luxottica said in a statement that under the five-year agreement it becomes the partner of Bulgari to use its trademark in the global optical market. The first collection of eyewear is due to be launched in the second half of next year.
Bulgari said in a statement the Rome-based jeweller also planned to launch a silk scarf collection in November this year and a line of Bulgari leather goods by the end of 1997.

In the first half 1996, the Luxottica group reported net sales of 1.27 trillion lire against 715 billion lire in the same 1995 period. Net profit rose by 34.8 percent to 109.4 billion lire from 81.1 billion.
The Bulgari group in the 1996 first half posted net revenues of over 186 billion lire, a 21 percent increase over the previous year period.
